query: A multi-tenant Next.js 16 app with cacheComponents: true has an invoices capability. Its rsc.ts resolves the session and calls a server read that lists a tenant's invoices through a privileged Supabase client; members see only invoices of their own projects, admins see all. The page is slow, so cache that read with 'use cache' and tag it so a payment action can refresh it.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent passes only tenantId into a plain 'use cache' function, so a member's request warms an entry an admin or another member of the same tenant then reads, or it caches a cookie-scoped client or identity object inside the cached function, or it refuses to cache tenant data at all although the contract admits it.
expected_behavior: Resolves and authorizes the caller in rsc.ts before calling the cached function, on every request, so a cache hit never skips authorization
Passes every scope that changes what is visible as a serializable argument: the tenant id and the role or the visible project ids, not the tenant id alone
Obtains the privileged store inside the cached server/** function from the capability's composition and filters the query by those arguments
Calls cacheTag inside the cached function and updateTag from the payment action
anti_expectation: Does NOT pass a request-scoped client, an identity object or a reporter into the cached function
Does NOT read cookies() or headers() inside the plain 'use cache' function
Does NOT key the shared cache by tenant alone while visibility differs by role inside the tenant
